run_flask_server: run the flask server by passing a data directory path as a command line argument
create_app: create the flask app by loading config.ini and initializing the PostText engine
query_posttext_engine: query the PostText engine via the GET /query endpoint with a query parameter
test_endpoint: test the flask server by hitting the GET /test endpoint with arbitrary query parameters
review_query_route: review the query route that returns prompt, sql_before, sql_after, and result from PostText
